summary: Full backend + frontend testing of NutriVane's new batch: hamburger AppMenu, unified Mood page (emoji/story/face + save + recommendations), Journal with object-storage photo upload, and Weekly AI Analysis (Claude Haiku 4.5). Backend: 8/8 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py covering auth guards, mood log CRUD (POST/GET/DELETE /api/mood/log(s)), Gemini POST /api/mood/analyze-text (returned a valid Indonesian mood key), journal upload -> object-storage path 'nutrivane/uploads/<uid>/<uuid>.jpg' + db.files insert, GET /api/files/{path}?auth=<jwt> serves image (401 without token, 200 image/* with token), journal CRUD, and POST/GET /api/analysis/weekly (summary + 3 patterns + 3 recs + nutrition_summary, GET returns latest saved). Frontend (mobile 390x844, demo login): hamburger data-testid=menu-button opens a right sheet with all 8 items (menu-home/scan/mood/diet/journal/weekly/history/profile), each navigates and closes the sheet. Mood page: emoji-senang -> mood-result card, save-mood posts and entry appears in mood-history ('Senang'); mood-story + analyze-story -> Gemini returns mood-result; craving-sweet + mood-get-recs -> mood-recs with rec-0..rec-N (3 items). Journal: journal-content + tag-food/tag-emotion + add-photo (real JPEG upload) + save-entry -> entry appears in journal-list with the photo rendered via /api/files/{path}?auth=token (img loaded 200). Weekly: report auto-loaded via GET on revisit; data-testid=weekly-report shows summary card + patterns + 3 recommendations + nutrition-summary. Bottom tab bar (tab-home/mood/scan/history/profile) intact on all authed pages.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' for SheetContent -- add SheetDescription (or aria-describedby) to /app/frontend/src/components/AppMenu.jsx for a11y.

action_items: Optional a11y: add SheetDescription inside AppMenu.jsx to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~800 lines and growing (weekly + journal + mood + files added). Splitting into routers/{mood,journal,weekly,files,foods,diet,auth}.py is overdue.

GET /api/files/{path} accepts JWT via ?auth= query string. Query-token auth is necessary for tags, but consider: (a) verifying the file belongs to the authed user (currently any authenticated user could fetch any file if they know the path), (b) short-lived signed URLs. Right now `_uid_from_token` returns uid but the file record isn't matched against it.

journal_upload: on put_object failure, the exception is caught and mapped to 502 but no cleanup is needed (nothing persisted); good. However there is no size cap or content-type validation beyond ext mapping -- add a max_bytes guard to prevent large base64 payloads from OOMing the worker.
Journal delete endpoint returns {ok: true} even when jid doesn't match any doc (deletes 0). Consider 404 when deleted_count==0 for stricter semantics.
mood/analyze-text prompt hard-codes the mood key set; consider making it a constant reused by mood/detect and mood/recommend for consistency.

Frontend: Journal.jsx builds photo URL as `${API}/files/${path}?auth=${token}` where token is read once from localStorage on mount -- if the user relogs, the img won't refresh until the page reloads. Minor.
seed_data_creation: None; test data uses TEST_ prefix and is self-cleaning (mood log, journal entry both created+deleted). Weekly report is idempotent (upsert-latest).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (8 tests, ~10s runtime). Weekly analysis uses Claude Haiku 4.5 and may take 15-40s under load; use timeout>=90s. Journal photos are served via GET /api/files/{path}?auth=<jwt>; verify with r.headers['content-type'].startswith('image/'). For UI, seed localStorage nv_token then goto '/journal' or '/weekly' to skip login. Note the a11y warning on Sheet component in AppMenu -- non-blocking. Face-detection UI path (data-testid=mood-take-photo/mood-file-input) was not exercised in UI (would require a real face photo) but backend /api/mood/detect contract is the same as /mood/analyze-text (Gemini) and covered indirectly.
